title: rpl_root_sig/CMakeLists.txt:42-44 stale NOTE: cites gcc-13 rejecting -std=c23, but test_common.cmake now probes
description: Codereview pass 3 on qjdp (worker3) flagged: lichen/tests/rpl_root_sig/CMakeLists.txt:42-44 NOTE says 'deliberately does not call lichen_test_target() — this host's gcc 13 rejects its -std=c23 flag'. That rationale went stale when test_common.cmake gained the check_c_compiler_flag probe (19fe1263ae, 2026-08-30): lichen_test_target no longer unconditionally adds -std=c23. The suite's other constraint (LICHEN_RPL_TEST=1 host byteorder stub) may still justify skipping lichen_test_target — but the NOTE should cite the real reason, or the suite should be re-evaluated for conversion to lichen_test_target (which would also gain it ASan/UBSan + the monocypher -Wno-conversion exemption; it currently has its own monocypher exclusion?). Pre-existing, traces to 19fe1263ae, not the qjdp diff. P4 comment-hygiene.
close_reason: Resolved by conversion rather than comment edit (commit 719b80fac5): rpl_root_sig now calls lichen_test_target — the stale NOTE's rationale (gcc-13 rejects -std=c23) has been dead since test_common.cmake's probe (19fe1263ae), and the suite gains hardening flags, UBSan (ASan pending d2tz's probe fix), the generic monocypher -Wno-conversion exemption, and ctest registration (add_test was entirely absent — 'ctest' previously reported no tests). Conversion surfaced and fixed a genuine pre-existing defect: dead 'uint8_t v_major' in root_dio_sig.c's CBOR map-value loop (-Werror=unused-variable); decode strictness unchanged (root_sig_read_uint reads major+arg internally). Vendored tinycrypt stubs got per-source -Wno-conversion mirroring coap_slot_claim policy. Verified: gcc-13.3.0 clean build under full hardening, ctest 1/1 PASS. 3x codereview (kimi-k3): PASS/PASS/PASS; two passes independently flagged the pre-existing repo-wide ASan probe false-negative — already tracked as project-LICHEN-worker6-d2tz (commented with Linux-gcc confirmation, no twin created).
